mapper.select: SELECT LR.*, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, ME.ENAME AS MGR_ENAME FROM LEAVE_REQUEST LR LEFT JOIN EMP E ON LR.EMPNO = E.EMPNO LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO LEFT JOIN EMP ME ON LR.MGR_EMPNO = ME.EMPNO WHERE LR.LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId}

SELECT LR.*, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, ME.ENAME AS MGR_ENAME FROM LEAVE_REQUEST LR LEFT JOIN EMP E ON LR.EMPNO = E.EMPNO LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO LEFT JOIN EMP ME ON LR.MGR_EMPNO = ME.EMPNO WHERE LR.EMPNO = #{empno} ORDER BY LR.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT * FROM LEAVE_BALANCE WHERE EMPNO = #{empno} AND YEAR = #{year}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LEAVE_BALANCE (EMPNO, YEAR, TOTAL_DAYS, USED_DAYS) VALUES (#{empno}, #{year}, 15, 0)

INSERT INTO LEAVE_REQUEST (LEAVE_ID, EMPNO, LEAVE_TYPE, START_DATE, END_DATE, DAYS, REASON, STATUS, MGR_EMPNO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (LEAVE_REQUEST_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{empno}, #{leaveType}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{days}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', #{mgrEmpno}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT LR.*, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, ME.ENAME AS MGR_ENAME FROM LEAVE_REQUEST LR LEFT JOIN EMP E ON LR.EMPNO = E.EMPNO LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO LEFT JOIN EMP ME ON LR.MGR_EMPNO = ME.EMPNO WHERE LR.MGR_EMPNO = #{mgrEmpno} AND LR.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY LR.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE LEAVE_REQUEST SET STATUS = #{status}, MGR_COMMENT = #{mgrComment}, MGR_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId} AND MGR_EMPNO = #{mgrEmpno} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT LR.*, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, ME.ENAME AS MGR_ENAME FROM LEAVE_REQUEST LR LEFT JOIN EMP E ON LR.EMPNO = E.EMPNO LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO LEFT JOIN EMP ME ON LR.MGR_EMPNO = ME.EMPNO ORDER BY LR.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE LEAVE_REQUEST SET STATUS = #{status}, ADMIN_COMMENT = #{adminComment}, ADMIN_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId} AND STATUS = 'MGR_APPROVED'
